scheme_name: Assistance for Intellectual Property Protection Support
other_conditions: The industrial unit must have made the investment on or after 1st April 2017.
At least 60% of the unit’s employment must be provided to residents of the Union Territory of Puducherry, and this proportion must be maintained during the period specified in the affidavit.
The unit must not transfer or dispose of any fixed assets, including plant and machinery, for five years from the later of the application submission date or subsidy disbursement date.
Additional investments made after the first claim are also eligible for subsidy up to the ceiling limit.
The commencement date declared by the entrepreneur is subject to verification by the Industries Department officials.
If the same person establishes two or more industrial units with common ownership but different locations and separate licenses/clearances, each unit is eligible as a separate entity.
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy covering 50% of patent filing costs up to ₹2,00,000 for domestic patents (₹5,00,000 for international patents).
